nodes.name: Trigger — Receive Email Data
nodes.notes: Receives the normalized email item from the main workflow: messageId, label, senderName, receivedDateFolder, driveRootFolderId, attachmentsMeta[].

nodes.name: Code — Get Or Create Label Folder
nodes.notes: Uses this node's own Google Drive credential (attach it after import: Settings tab → Credential). Search-then-create in one call = no duplicate folders, no orphaned branches.

nodes.name: Code — Get Or Create Date Folder
nodes.notes: Uses this node's own Google Drive credential (attach it after import: Settings tab → Credential). Search-then-create in one call = no duplicate folders, no orphaned branches.

nodes.name: Code — Get Or Create Sender Folder
nodes.notes: Uses this node's own Google Drive credential (attach it after import: Settings tab → Credential). Search-then-create in one call = no duplicate folders, no orphaned branches.

nodes.name: Split — Each Attachment
nodes.notes: Splits the attachments array into one item per file. 'Include other fields' keeps senderFolderId/messageId available on every resulting item.

nodes.name: Gmail — Download Attachment
nodes.notes: Preserves the raw attachment bytes as binary data 'data', ready for Drive upload.

nodes.name: Drive — Upload Attachment
nodes.notes: Filename comes straight from the original Gmail attachment metadata — never renamed. MIME type is inferred by Drive from the binary data.

nodes.name: Aggregate — Collect Uploaded Files
nodes.notes: Combines however many attachments this one email had back into a single item, so the main workflow gets exactly one result per email.
